name: Arigato Universe Limited
about: Arigato Universe Limited manufactures and trades in construction-related materials and commodities in India. It operates through Manufacturing/Trading and Services segments. The company engages in infrastructure development projects, including roads, drainage systems, industrial parks, bridges, RCC works, and metro station construction. It is also involved in the provision of construction related materials and commodities; execution of contracts related to real estate and development of land; development and dealing in immovable properties; and development of properties for hospitality and recreational activities and related services. The company was formerly known as Saboo Brothers Limited and changed its name to Arigato Universe Limited in March 2024. Arigato Universe Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Nagpur, India.
